title: Vintage Kodak Mickey-Matic Camera, Disney Black/Blue - Untested
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Mickey Matic Kodak camera with a Disney theme, featuring a black and blue color scheme measuring 4.5 inches in size. Although it is untested, this collectible camera is sure to appeal to Disney enthusiasts and vintage camera collectors alike. With its unique design and nostalgic charm, this camera could make a great addition to any photography or Disney memorabilia collection.
